movesets.name: Physical Wall
movesets.description:
Physically defensive Mareanie is a bulky pivot that enters the game on strong attacks, such as Mienfoo's High Jump Kick. Once on the field, its good coverage can threaten various foes. Ice Beam threatens an incoming Foongus or Toedscool, Mud Shot hits opposing Mareanie and slows incoming Pokemon that would be faster than itself. Mareanie invests in bulk in order to stomach Flare Blitz from Hisuian Growlithe and High Jump Kick from Mienfoo even after its Eviolite has been removed. Its Special Defense EVs allow Mareanie to check Wingull and survive Gothita's Psychic from full HP. Tera Dragon provides insurance against the Electric-types in Elekid and Chinchou. Mareanie also has the option of using Tera Ghost to escape being trapped by Shadow Tag Gothita and to surprise a Choice Scarf Mienfoo, which is expected to 2HKO after Spikes with Reckless-boosted High Jump Kick.

Mareanie and Mienfoo form a double Regenerator core. Nearly everything benefits from Mareanie's ability to check Mienfoo, notably Rock and Steel-types like Glimmet and Alolan Sandshrew. Mareanie partners well with Toedscool, which is OHKOed by Flare Blitz from Hisuian Growlithe. Mareanie is weak to Spikes, Electric-types, and Ground-types, all which Toedscool covers in return. Mareanie and Tinkatink also make good partners because of their capacity to cover the dual threat of Mienfoo and Vullaby; with Mareanie taking High Jump Kick for Tinkatink, which absorbs Knock Off and takes Brave Bird. Gothita can be a huge thorn because it threatens to trap and remove Mareanie. It is wise to pair Mareanie with a Dark-type like Vullaby or Stunky to take advantage of a Choice Scarf Gothita locked into Psychic.

movesets.name: Offensive Wall
movesets.description:
Offensive Mareanie leverages its natural bulk, typing, and Regenerator to invest in its Special Attack, making it much more threatening. Mud Shot allows Mareanie to hit a variety of Pokemon: Elekid, Chinchou, Stunky, Tinkatink, Glimmet, and opposing Mareanie, with the bonus of making Mareanie faster than the latter two after one hit. Ice Beam hits Ground- and Grass-types like Mudbray, Toedscool, and Foongus as well as Vullaby super effectively. Sacrificing some of its Special Defense, Mareanie invests heavily into its Special Attack, which improves its damage rolls against much of the tier, notably allowing it to 2HKO Foongus with Ice Beam after Stealth Rock. Due to the loss of bulk, however, Mareanie has a harder time defending against Pokemon like Alolan Sandshrew and Stunky. Tera Dragon protects Mareanie from Elekid and Chinchou, while Tera Ghost allows it to escape Gothita's Shadow Tag and block Rapid Spin from Toedscool and Alolan Sandshrew.

Mareanie complements Pokemon that are threatened by Mienfoo, such as Alolan Sandshrew. In return, Alolan Sandshrew can remove entry hazards with Rapid Spin, which helps Mareanie last longer despite its lessened bulk. Grookey is a great partner, as it can check the Ground-types that threaten Mareanie, with the Grassy Terrain it provides keeping Mareanie healthy and halving the power of Earthquake. Toedscool fills a similar role to Grookey, as it can check Ground-types while being a better switch-in to Electric-types than Grookey, in addition to its ability to clear hazards. Dark-type teammates that can take advantage of a Gothita trapping Mareanie are also appreciated.
